ValidationRule.description: Prevents updates to PHOCS Assessment records when Status is Completed, unless the user has the EHIS Bypass Validation Rule custom permission.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( RecordType.DeveloperName = "PHOCSAssessment", NOT($Permission.EHISBypassValidationRuleCustomPermission), ISPICKVAL(Type, "Risk Assessment"), NOT(ISNEW()), OR( AND( ISPICKVAL(AssessmentStatus, "Completed"), NOT(ISCHANGED(AssessmentStatus)) ), AND( ISCHANGED(AssessmentStatus), ISPICKVAL(PRIORVALUE(AssessmentStatus), "Completed") ) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Assessment record cannot be edited once the status is marked as Completed
